notes.f1: Not recovered -- the subject's (PID-TODO) Birth fact in the final tree is byte-identical to the starting tree ("about 1910... near Nueva Italia, Michoacan", a pre-existing, unverified fact). The run never searched Guerrero civil registration at all -- the locality-guide anchored the whole search in Michoacan/Paracuaro, matching the family's later 1930 residence rather than the birthplace, even though three already-in-tree siblings (Miguel, Liborio, Facundo) all have birth places in Guerrero, a strong hint the run never acted on. The one birth date it did find, on an unmerged stub (I1, "~1912"), is wrong on both year and state.
notes.f2: Not recovered on the subject. The agent found the correct father's name -- Sostenes Cruz -- via a genuine 1941 Paracuaro marriage investigation file (record_search hit, then record_read, then extraction_append), and wrote a ParentChild relationship. But that relationship (R1) connects I2 (Sostenes Cruz) to I1, a brand-new stub person, not to PID-TODO (the actual research subject). PID-TODO has zero relationships in the final tree, identical to the starting tree. Correction after review (EdmondOware), verified against tool_calls: this is not an unresolved identity call or a skipped merge step. same_person ran once (index 72), comparing the new record's persons against the subject's own known facts (birth about 1910 near Nueva Italia, death 1999), and returned a decisive non-match -- matched: false, score 0.013. The agent then tried to merge anyway, calling merge_warnings twice (indices 73-74) with merges: [["I1","p_308026288382"]]: the first attempt was rejected for a malformed candidateGedcomx ("sources[0]: missing required field 'title'"), and after fixing that, the second was rejected because "merge survivor id I1 not found in target_gedcomx" -- I1 did not exist yet at that point. Correction after a second review pass (EdmondOware): I1 is created one call later, at index 75, by materialize_facts ("personId": "I1", "created": true), not by tree_edit four calls later as an earlier version of this note said -- tree_edit at index 78 only adds relationships (add_relationship ops), no person creation. merge_tree_persons was never called at all (0 of 96 tool calls). So the agent attempted the correct precursor twice, was turned away both times, then created I1 via materialize_facts and wired the relationships directly via tree_edit -- never returning to merge_warnings or merge_tree_persons to actually attach I1 to the subject. Escalated to the lead given the right name was found but never attached to the subject; ruling: false, since the required relationship does not exist on the tree's own subject regardless of the underlying evidence quality. Tool-interaction defect filed separately: #2829.
notes.f3: Not recovered on the subject, same root cause and same lead ruling as f2. The mother's name (Ma Apolinar Corona / Apolinar Corona) was correctly found in the same marriage file and independently corroborated by a 1930 census household match -- stronger corroboration than f2 had. But the ParentChild edge (R2) again connects I3 to the unmerged stub I1, not to PID-TODO. Same verified cause as f2 -- a decisive same_person non-match followed by two rejected merge_warnings attempts (see f2's note for the exact sequence), not an unresolved call or a skipped step.
